hooks.name: Frontend: docs freshness
hooks.description: Targets EntraUi (Angular 19). Fires when an Angular service or component TypeScript file is saved (these carry auth wiring and API calls). Reminds the agent to update the relevant DOC/*.md when UI/auth/API behavior changes. PostFileSave matchers are tested against the FILE PATH.

action.prompt:
An Angular service (*.service.ts) or component (*.component.ts) under EntraUi/ was just saved. Services and components carry the app's auth wiring and API calls, so the human-readable docs may now be stale.

Check whether the change affects any of the following and, if so, propose concrete edits to keep them in sync:
- DOC/API.md: which backend endpoints the UI calls, verbs, and expected request/response shapes.
- DOC/SECURITY.md: MSAL configuration, login/logout flow, scopes/audience requested, the protected-resource map (which origins get a bearer token), and the reminder that the backend is the real authorization boundary.
- DOC/CONFIGURATION.md: any client IDs, authority/tenant, redirect URIs, or API base URLs that changed.
- DOC/ARCHITECTURE.md: if a new component/service changes the front-end structure or data flow.

List exactly what changed and which doc sections need updating. Suggest minimal, accurate edits. Only apply doc edits if the user confirms.
